notablePrerequisites:
Strionic Resonator does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn, Legacy Reforged triggers.
Holding priority, activate Karn, Silver Golem by paying {1}, causing Strionic Resonator to become an artifact creature until end  of turn.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn, Legacy Reforged's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn, Legacy Reforged's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 3.
